ID_WOTC_DMG24_INFORMATION_AVATAR_OF_DEAT.name: Avatar de la Muerte
ID_WOTC_DMG24_INFORMATION_AVATAR_OF_DEAT.description:
Muerto viviente Mediano, Neutral malvado

- CA 20

- Iniciativa +3 (13)

- PG Half the HP maximum of its summoner

- Velocidad 60 pies, Volar 60 pies (hover)

| MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE
STR | 16 | +3 | +3 | DEX | 16 | +3 | +3 | CON | 16 | +3 | +3
INT | 16 | +3 | +3 | WIS | 16 | +3 | +3 | CHA | 16 | +3 | +3

- Sentidos Visión verdadera 60 pies, Percepción pasiva 13

- Idiomas All languages known to its summoner

- CR None (XP 0; PB equals its summoner's)

Rasgos

Incorporeal Movement. The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) de daño de fuerza if it ends its turn inside an object.

Acciones

Multiattack. The avatar makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the summoner's Proficiency Bonus (rounded up).

Reaping Scythe. Tirada de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: Automatic hit, alcance 5 pies Impacto: 7 (1d8 + 3) de daño cortante plus 4 (1d8) de daño necrótico.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_ARTIFACT_TABLE.name: Propiedades de artefactos
ID_WOTC_DMG24_ARTIFACT_TABLE.description:
Minor Beneficial Properties

1d100 | Property
01-20 | While attuned to the Artifact, you gain proficiency in one skill of the DM's choice.
21-30 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Immunity to the Venenoed condition.
31-40 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions.
41-50 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Resistance to one damage type of the DM's choice.
51-60 | While attuned to the Artifact, you can cast one cantrip (chosen by the DM) from it.
61-70 | While attuned to the Artifact, you can cast one level 1 spell (chosen by the DM) from it. After you cast the spell, roll 1d6. On a roll of 1–5, you can't cast it again in this way until the next dawn.
71-80 | As 61–70 above, except the spell is level 2.
81-90 | As 61–70 above, except the spell is level 3.
91-00 | While attuned to the Artifact, you gain a +1 bonus to Clase de Armadura.

Major Beneficial Properties

1d100 | Property
01-20 | While attuned to the Artifact, one of your ability scores (DM's choice) increases by 2, to a maximum of 24.
21-30 | While attuned to the Artifact, you regain 1d6 Puntos de golpe at the start of each of your turns if you have at least 1 Hit Point.
31-40 | When you hit with an attack roll while attuned to the Artifact, the target takes an extra 1d6 de daño de fuerza.
41-50 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, your Speed increases by 10 pies.
51-60 | While attuned to the Artifact, you can cast one level 4 spell (chosen by the DM) from it. After you cast the spell, roll 1d6. On a roll of 1–5, you can't cast it again in this way until the next dawn.
61-70 | As 51–60 above, except the spell is level 5.
71-80 | As 51–60 above, except the spell is level 6.
81-90 | As 51–60 above, except the spell is level 7.
91-00 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Immunity to the Cegado, Deafened, Petrified, and Stunned conditions.

Minor Detrimental Properties

1d100 | Property
01-08 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Desventaja on any ability check or tirada de salvación that uses Strength or Constitution.
09-16 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Desventaja on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma tirada de salvacións.
17-24 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Vulnerability to de daño de veneno.
25-32 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have the Cegado condition when you're more than 10 pies away from it.
33-40 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have the Deafened condition when you're more than 10 pies away from it.
41-48 | While attuned to the Artifact, you lose all sense of smell.
49-66 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, your appearance changes as the DM decides.
67-72 | While attuned to the Artifact, you emit a sour stench noticeable from up to 10 pies away.
73-76 | Whenever you touch a nonmagical gem or an art object while attuned to this Artifact, the value of the gem or art object is reduced by half. This affects a particular object only once.
77-80 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, all Holy Water within 10 pies of you is destroyed.
81-84 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, nonmagical flames are extinguished within 30 pies of you.
85-88 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, other creatures can't take Short or Long Rests while within 300 pies of you.
89-92 | While attuned to the Artifact, you kill any nonmagical vegetation you touch that isn't a creature.
93-00 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, Beasts within 30 pies of you that have a Desafío Rating of 6 or lower are Hostile toward you.

Major Detrimental Properties

1d100 | Property
01-09 | You can't attune to other magic items while you're attuned to the Artifact. When you become attuned to the Artifact, your Attunement to other magic items ends immediately.
10-18 | When you become attuned to the Artifact, a random one of your ability scores is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 3. A Greater Restoration spell restores the ability.
19-27 | When you become attuned to the Artifact, you take 8d10 de daño psíquico.
28-36 | The first time you become attuned to the Artifact, it gives you a quest determined by the DM. You can't use any of the Artifact's properties until you complete the quest.
37-45 | Each time you become attuned to the Artifact, there is a 10 percent chance that you attract the attention of a god who sends an avatar to wrest the Artifact from you. The avatar has the same alignment as its creator and uses the Empyrean stat block. Once it obtains the Artifact, the avatar vanishes.
46-54 | Each time you become attuned to the Artifact, you must succeed on a CD 10 tirada de salvación de Constitución or die from the shock. If you die, you're instantly transformed into a Wight under the DM's control that must protect the Artifact.
55-63 | The Artifact dilutes potions within 10 pies of itself, rendering them nonmagical.
64-72 | The Artifact erases scrolls within 10 pies of itself, rendering them nonmagical.
73-81 | While you're attuned to the Artifact, creatures of a particular type other than Humanoid (chosen by the DM) are always Hostile toward you.
82-90 | While attuned to the Artifact, you have Vulnerability to all damage.
91-96 | The Artifact imprisons a Death Slaad . Each time you become attuned to the Artifact, the slaad has a 10 percent chance of escaping, whereupon it appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible and attacks you.
97-00 | While attuned to the Artifact, you can't spend Hit Point Dice or regain Puntos de golpe.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_CONTACT.name: Veneno de contacto
ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_CONTACT.description: El veneno de contacto puede untarse sobre un objeto y permanece activo hasta que alguien lo toca o se lava. Una criatura que toca el veneno con la piel expuesta sufre sus efectos.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INGESTED.name: Veneno ingerido
ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INGESTED.description: Una criatura debe tragar una dosis completa de veneno ingerido para sufrir sus efectos. La dosis puede administrarse en comida o bebida.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INHALED.name: Veneno inhalado
ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INHALED.description: Los polvos y gases venenosos surten efecto al ser inhalados. Soplar el polvo o liberar el gas somete a las criaturas en un cubo de 5 pies a su efecto. La nube resultante se disipa de inmediato.

ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INJURY.name: Veneno de herida
ID_WOTC_DMG24_RULE_POISON_INJURY.description: El veneno de herida puede aplicarse como acción adicional a un arma, una pieza de munición u objeto similar. Permanece activo durante 1 minuto o hasta que inflijas daño con el objeto envenenado.

ID_WOTC_MM25_INFORMATION_AIR_ELEMENTAL_S.description:

- CA 15

- Iniciativa +5 (15)

- PG 90 (12d10 + 24)

- Velocidad 10 pies, Volar 90 pies (levitar)

| MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE

INT | 6 | -2 | -2 | WIS | 10 | +0 | +0 | CHA | 6 | -2 | -2

- Resistances Contundente, Relámpago, Perforante, Cortante

- Immunities Veneno, Trueno; Agotamiento, Agarrado, Paralizado, Petrificado, Venenoed, Derribado, Apresado, Inconsciente

- Sentidos Visión en la oscuridad 60 pies, Percepción pasiva 10

- Idiomas Primordial (Auran)

- CR 5 (XP 1,800; PB +3)

Rasgos

Air Form. The elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

Acciones

Multiattack. The elemental makes two Truenoous Slam attacks.

Truenoous Slam. Tirada de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: +8, alcance 10 pies Impacto: 14 (2d8 + 5) de daño de trueno.

Whirlwind. (Recarga 4–6) Tirada de salvación de Fuerza: CD 13, one Mediano or smaller creature in the elemental's space. Fallo: 24 (4d10 + 2) de daño de trueno, and the target is pushed up to 20 pies straight away from the elemental and has the Derribado condition. Éxito: Half damage only.

ID_WOTC_MM25_INFORMATION_ANIMAL_LORD_STA.name: Señor de los animales
ID_WOTC_MM25_INFORMATION_ANIMAL_LORD_STA.description:
Mediano Celestial, Neutral

- CA 19

- Iniciativa +19 (29)

- PG 323 (34d8 + 170)

- Velocidad 60 pies, Volar 60 pies (levitar), Nadar 60 pies

| MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE
STR | 24 | +7 | +7 | DEX | 25 | +7 | +7 | CON | 20 | +5 | +11
INT | 19 | +4 | +4 | WIS | 23 | +6 | +12 | CHA | 22 | +6 | +6

- Habilidades Acrobatics +13, Athletics +13, Perception +18, Stealth +13

- Resistances Frío, Fuego, Necrótico, Psíquico, Radiante

- Immunities Hechizado, Asustado, Aturdido

- Sentidos Visión verdadera 120 pies, Percepción pasiva 28

- Idiomas All

- CR 20 (XP 25,000; PB +6)

Rasgos

Animal Lordship. An animal lord represents a Forager, Hunter, or Sage (DM's choice), which determines certain traits in this stat block.

Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the animal lord fails a tirada de salvación, it can choose to succeed instead.

Lordly Presence. Tirada de salvación de Sabiduría: CD 20, any enemy that starts its turn in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the animal lord. Fallo: The target suffers one of the following effects:

Captivated (Forager Only). The target has the Hechizado condition hasta el final de its próximo turno. While Hechizado, the target has the Incapacitado condition.

Fearful (Hunter Only). The target has the Asustado condition hasta el final de its próximo turno.

Mired (Sage Only). The target takes 10 (3d6) de daño psíquico, and the target is magically bewildered hasta el final de its próximo turno. While bewildered, the target subtracts 1d4 from its tiradas de salvación.

Magic Resistance. The animal lord has Ventaja on tiradas de salvación against conjuros y otros efectos mágicos.

Acciones

Multiattack. The animal lord makes two attacks, using Rend or Radiante Ray in any combination, and uses Animal Spirit.

Rend. Tirada de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: +13, alcance 5 pies Impacto: 14 (2d6 + 7) de daño cortante más 7 (2d6) de daño de fuerza.

Radiante Ray. Tirada de ataque a distancia: +12, alcance 120 pies Impacto: 20 (4d6 + 6) de daño radiante.

Animal Spirit. The animal lord conjures an animal spirit that strikes at a creature and then disappears. Tirada de salvación de Destreza: CD 20, one creature the animal lord can see within 120 pies. Fallo: 28 (4d10 + 6) de daño radiante. Éxito: Half damage. Failure or Éxito: One of the following effects occurs:

Fortify (Forager Only). The animal lord gains 20 Temporary Puntos de golpe.

Marked as Prey (Hunter Only). The animal lord has Ventaja on tirada de ataques against the target hasta el comienzo de the animal lord's próximo turno.

Pesky Swarm (Sage Only). The target has Desventaja on tirada de ataques and prueba de características hasta el final de its próximo turno.

Spellcasting. The animal lord casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save CD 20):

At Will: Animal Friendship, Animal Messenger, Speak with Animals

2/Día Each: Awaken, Greater Restoration

1/Día Each (Sage Only): Animal Shapes, Sunburst

Bonus Acciones

Shape-Shift. The animal lord shape-shifts into a Enorme or smaller version of the animal it represents or a Mediano or Pequeño Humanoide, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Legendary Acciones

Legendary Action Uses: 3. Immediately after another creature's turn, the animal lord can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The animal lord regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

Feral Strike. The animal lord moves up to its Speed without provoking ataques de oportunidad, and it makes one Rend attack.

Radiante Strike. The animal lord makes one Radiante Ray attack.

ID_WOTC_MM25_INFORMATION_BLOB_OF_ANNIHIL.description:
Gargantuesco Cieno (Titán), Neutral malvado

- CA 18

- Iniciativa +16 (26)

- PG 448 (23d20 + 207)

- Velocidad 30 pies

| MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE |  | MOD | SAVE
STR | 27 | +8 | +8 | DEX | 14 | +2 | +9 | CON | 28 | +9 | +16
INT | 10 | +0 | +0 | WIS | 16 | +3 | +3 | CHA | 10 | +0 | +0

- Resistances Contundente, Perforante, Cortante

- Immunities Ácido, Necrótico, Veneno; Hechizado, Agotamiento, Asustado, Agarrado, Paralizado, Petrificado, Venenoed, Derribado, Apresado, Aturdido, Inconsciente

- Sentidos Vista ciega 120 pies, Percepción pasiva 13

- Idiomas None

- CR 23 (XP 50,000; PB +7)

Rasgos

Astral Implosion. If the blob is reduced to 0 Puntos de golpe, it implodes and ejects any creatures and objects engulfed by it into the Astral Sea. The blob itself vanishes, leaving behind a layer of slime on everything that was within 600 pies of it. In 1d20 years, the blob reconstitutes on a random world in the Material Plane.

Legendary Resistance (4/Day). If the blob fails a tirada de salvación, it can choose to succeed instead.

Magic Resistance. The blob has Ventaja on tiradas de salvación against conjuros y otros efectos mágicos.

Acciones

Multiattack. The blob makes two Pseudopod attacks and uses Engulf. It can replace one attack with a use of Restraining Glob.

Pseudopod. Tirada de ataque cuerpo a cuerpo: +15, alcance 30 pies Impacto: 24 (3d10 + 8) de daño de fuerza.

Engulf. The blob moves up to its Speed and can move through the spaces of Enorme or smaller creatures and objects. Tirada de salvación de Fuerza: CD 23, each creature or object whose space the blob enters for the first time during this move. Fallo: The target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the blob, and when the blob moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A nonmagical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed.

While engulfed, a creature takes 21 (6d6) de daño de fuerza at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, has the Apresado condition, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 Puntos de golpe dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea.

Éxito: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

Restraining Glob. The blob lobs a slimy glob at one Grande or smaller creature it can see within 600 pies of itself. Tirada de salvación de Destreza: CD 23, the targeted creature. Fallo: 18 (3d6 + 8) de daño de ácido. The glob rolls the target 60 pies straight toward the blob, and the target has the Apresado condition hasta el final de its próximo turno, when the glob harmlessly dissolves. ID_WOTC_PHB24_INFORMATION_FIGHTER_BATTLE.name: Opciones de maniobra (Maestro de batalla)
ID_WOTC_PHB24_INFORMATION_FIGHTER_BATTLE.description:
The maneuvers are presented here in alphabetical order.

Ambush. When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check or an Initiative roll, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the roll, unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

Bait and Switch. When you’re within 5 pies of a creature on your turn, you can expend one Superiority Die and switch places with that creature, provided you spend at least 5 pies of movement and the creature is willing and doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. This movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Roll the Superiority Die. Until the start of your next turn, you or the other creature (your choice) gains a bonus to AC equal to the number rolled.

Commander’s Strike. When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks to direct one of your companions to strike. When you do so, choose a willing creature who can see or hear you and expend one Superiority Die. That creature can immediately use its Reacción to make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, adding the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll on a hit.

Commanding Presence. When you make a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the roll.

Disarming Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to disarm the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack’s de daño roll. The target must succeed on a Strength tirada de salvación or drop one object of your choice that it’s holding, with the object landing in its space.

Distracting Strike. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to distract the target. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack’s de daño roll. The next attack roll against the target by an attacker other than you has Ventaja if the attack is made before the start of your next turn.

Evasive Footwork. As a Acción adicional, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Disengage action. You also roll the die and add the number rolled to your AC until the start of your next turn.

Feinting Attack. As a Acción adicional, you can expend one Superiority Die to feint, choosing one creature within 5 pies of yourself as your target. You have Ventaja on your next attack roll against that target this turn. If that attack hits, add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll.

Goading Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to goad the target into attacking you. Add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom tirada de salvación or have Desventaja on attack rolls against targets other than you until the end of your next turn.

Lunging Attack. As a Acción adicional, you can expend one Superiority Die and take the Dash action. If you move at least 5 pies in a straight line immediately before hitting with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on this turn, you can add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll.

Maneuvering Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to maneuver one of your comrades into another position. Add the Superiority Die roll to the attack’s de daño roll, and choose a willing creature who can see or hear you. That creature can use its Reacción to move up to half its Velocidad without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target of your attack.

Menacing Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to frighten the target. Add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll. The target must succeed on a Wisdom tirada de salvación or have the Asustado condition until the end of your next turn.

Parry. When another creature de daños you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reacción and expend one Superiority Die to reduce the de daño by the number you roll on your Superiority Die plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

Precision Attack. When you miss with an attack roll, you can expend one Superiority Die, roll that die, and add it to the attack roll, potentially causing the attack to hit.

Pushing Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to drive the target back. Add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength tirada de salvación or be pushed up to 15 pies directly away from you.

Rally. As a Acción adicional, you can expend one Superiority Die to bolster the resolve of a companion. Choose an ally of yours within 30 pies of yourself who can see or hear you. That creature gains Temporary Puntos de golpe equal to the Superiority Die roll plus half your Fighter level (round down).

Riposte. When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can take a Reacción and expend one Superiority Die to make a melee attack roll with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the creature. If you hit, add the Superiority Die to the attack’s de daño.

Sweeping Attack. When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die to attempt to de daño another creature. Choose another creature within 5 pies of the original target and within your alcance. If the original attack roll would hit the second creature, it takes de daño equal to the number you roll on your Superiority Die. The de daño is of the same type dealt by the original attack.

Tactical Assessment. When you make an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, you can expend one Superiority Die and add that die to the ability check.

Trip Attack. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you can expend one Superiority Die and add the die to the attack’s de daño roll. If the target is Large or smaller, it must succeed on a Strength tirada de salvación or have the Derribado condition.

setters.short: If you’d like your character to follow their own path, you may ignore your Ability Score Increase trait and assign ability score increases tailored to your character.

ID_WOTC_TCOE_OPTION_CUSTOMIZED_ASI.description:
El rasgo Mejora de Puntuación de Característica de una raza refleja un rasgo arquetípico de excelencia en los aventureros de esta clase en el pasado de D&D. Por ejemplo, si eres un enano, tu Constitución aumenta en 2, porque los héroes enanos en D&D suelen ser excepcionalmente resistentes. Este aumento no se aplica a todos los enanos, solo a los enanos aventureros, y existe para reforzar un arquetipo. Ese refuerzo es apropiado si quieres inclinarte por el arquetipo, pero no resulta útil si tu personaje no se ajusta a él.

Si deseas que tu personaje siga su propio camino, puedes ignorar tu rasgo Mejora de Puntuación de Característica y asignar mejoras de puntuación de característica a la medida de tu personaje. Así es como se hace: toma cualquier mejora de puntuación de característica que obtengas por tu raza o subraza y aplícala a una puntuación de característica de tu elección. Si obtienes más de una mejora, no puedes aplicar esas mejoras a la misma puntuación de característica, y no puedes aumentar una puntuación por encima de 20.

Por ejemplo, si el rasgo Mejora de Puntuación de Característica de tu raza o subraza aumenta tu Constitución en 2 y tu Sabiduría en 1, podrías en su lugar aumentar tu Inteligencia en 2 y tu Carisma en 1.

ID_WOTC_TCOE_OPTION_CUSTOMIZED_PROFICIEN.name: Competencias Personalizadas

setters.short: You can replace each of your racial proficiencies with a different one, as shown on the Proficiency Swaps table.

ID_WOTC_TCOE_OPTION_CUSTOMIZED_PROFICIEN.description:
Algunas razas que incluyen el rasgo Mejora de Puntuación de Característica también otorgan competencias. Estas competencias suelen ser culturales, pero es posible que tu personaje no tenga ninguna conexión con la cultura en cuestión o que haya seguido un entrenamiento diferente. Puedes reemplazar cada una de esas competencias por otra diferente, tal como se muestra en la tabla Intercambio de Competencias.

INTERCAMBIO DE COMPETENCIAS

Competencia | Competencia de reemplazo
Habilidad | Habilidad
Armadura | Arma simple/marcial o herramienta
Arma simple | Arma simple o herramienta
Arma marcial | Arma simple/marcial o herramienta
Herramienta | Herramienta o arma simple

ID_WOTC_TCOE_OPTION_CUSTOMIZED_LANGUAGE.name: Idioma personalizado

setters.short: You may replace each language in your Languages trait with a language from the following list: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Deep Speech, Draconic, Dwarvish, Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Goblin, Halfling, Infernal, Orc, Primordial, Sylvan, or Undercommon

ID_WOTC_TCOE_OPTION_CUSTOMIZED_LANGUAGE.description:
Si la raza de tu personaje tiene el rasgo Idiomas, ese rasgo incluye los idiomas que se supone que tu personaje conoce, normalmente común y el idioma de tus ancestros. Por ejemplo, se supone que un aventurero mediano conoce común y mediano. Pero la cuestión es esta: los aventureros de D&D son extraordinarios, y tu personaje podría haber crecido hablando idiomas diferentes a los de su rasgo Idiomas.

Para personalizar los idiomas que conoces, puedes reemplazar cada idioma de tu rasgo Idiomas por un idioma de la siguiente lista: abisal, celestial, común, habla profunda, dracónico, enano, élfico, gigante, gnomo, goblin, mediano, infernal, orco, primordial, silvano o infracomún

ID_WOTC_SOURCE_TASHAS_CAULDRON_OF_EVERYT.name: El caldero de Tasha para todo
ID_WOTC_SOURCE_TASHAS_CAULDRON_OF_EVERYT.description:
Una mezcla mágica de opciones de reglas para el mejor juego de rol del mundo.

La maga Tasha, entre cuyas grandes obras se incluye el conjuro risa horrible de Tasha, ha reunido retazos y secretos de valioso saber durante su ilustre carrera como aventurera. Sus enemigos no querrían ver estos preciados secretos esparcidos por el multiverso, así que, desafiándolos, ha recopilado y codificado estos conocimientos para el enriquecimiento de todos.

- SUBCLASES AMPLIADAS. Prueba opciones de subclase para todas las clases de Dungeons & Dragons, incluido el artífice, que aparece en el libro.

- MÁS OPCIONES DE PERSONAJE. Sumérgete en una colección de nuevos rasgos de clase y nuevas dotes, y personaliza el origen de tu personaje usando reglas sencillas para modificar los rasgos raciales.

- PRESENTACIÓN DE PATRONES DE GRUPO. Tanto si formáis parte del mismo sindicato criminal como si trabajáis para un dragón antiguo, cada opción de patrón de grupo incluye sus propios beneficios y tipos de encargos.

- CONJUROS, ARTEFACTOS Y TATUAJES MÁGICOS. Descubre más conjuros, así como tatuajes mágicos, artefactos y otros objetos mágicos para tu campaña.

- OPCIONES DE REGLAS AMPLIADAS. Prueba reglas para acompañantes, entornos sobrenaturales, peligros naturales y negociar con monstruos, y obtén consejos para dirigir una sesión cero.

- UNA PLÉTORA DE ACERTIJOS. Listos para incluirse en cualquier aventura de D&D, acertijos de diversa dificultad esperan a tus aventureros, completos con trampas y consejos para usarlos en una campaña.

Repleto de contenido ampliado tanto para jugadores como para Dungeon Masters, este libro es un gran complemento para el Manual del Jugador y la Guía del Dungeon Master. En su interior encontrarás más opciones de reglas para todas las clases de personaje del Manual del Jugador, incluidas más opciones de subclase. Como añadido especial se incluye la clase artífice, maestro de la invención mágica. Y este brebaje de bruja no estaría completo sin una pizca de artefactos adicionales, opciones de libro de conjuros, conjuros tanto para personajes jugadores como para monstruos, tatuajes mágicos, patrones de grupo y otras delicias.

ID_WOTC_SOURCE_XANATHARS_GUIDE_TO_EVERYT.name: Guía del Xanathar para Todo
ID_WOTC_SOURCE_XANATHARS_GUIDE_TO_EVERYT.description:
Explora una gran cantidad de nuevas opciones de reglas tanto para jugadores como para Dungeon Masters en este suplemento para el mejor juego de rol del mundo.

El contemplador Xanathar —el señor del crimen más infame de Aguas Profundas— es conocido por acumular información sobre amigos y enemigos por igual. El contemplador cataloga conocimientos sobre aventureros y medita métodos para frustrarlos. ¡Su mente retorcida imagina que algún día podrá registrarlo todo!

La Guía del Xanathar para Todo es la primera gran expansión para la quinta edición de Dungeons & Dragons, que ofrece nuevas reglas y opciones de historia:

- Más de veinticinco nuevas subclases para las clases de personaje del Manual del Jugador, incluyendo el Caballero para el guerrero, el Círculo de los Sueños para el druida, el Caminante del Horizonte para el explorador, el Inquisitivo para el pícaro y muchas más.

- Docenas de nuevos conjuros, una colección de dotes raciales y un sistema para darle a tu personaje un trasfondo aleatorio.

- Una variedad de herramientas que proporcionan a los Dungeon Masters nuevas formas de usar trampas, objetos mágicos, actividades entre aventuras y más, todo diseñado para enriquecer una campaña de D&D y llevarla en nuevas direcciones.

En medio de todo este material de expansión, Xanathar ofrece observaciones estrafalarias sobre cualquier cosa que sus pedúnculos oculares alcancen a vislumbrar. Reza para que no se posen sobre ti.

¡La belleza y la astucia están en los ojos del contemplador!
